commands.name: search-cities
commands.summary: Search cities by name. Returns numeric city ids and labels; use the id with get-today-times.

commands.name: get-today-times
commands.summary: Get today's and tomorrow's sunrise/sunset widget for a city, selected by numeric id. Returns JSON with pre-rendered HTML fragments.

commands.name: list-popular-today
commands.summary: Get today's sunrise/sunset cards for the most-searched cities in the visitor's country (grid), or for the visitor's geolocated city (geo).

commands.name: get-sun-times
commands.summary: Public JSON API: sunrise, sunset, solar noon, day length and twilight times for a latitude/longitude on one date or across a date range.

commands.name: get-location-page
commands.summary: Open a city or region page by country code and slug (e.g. fr/paris, jp/tokyo, jp/tokyo-prefecture). Returns the page heading, title and meta description.

commands.name: list-countries
commands.summary: List all countries on the explore page. Each link leads to a country listing of regions and cities.

commands.name: list-country-locations
commands.summary: List the regions and cities for a country by its full-name slug (e.g. japan). Links point to /{cc}/{slug} pages usable with get-location-page.

commands.name: get-monthly-calendar
commands.summary: Get the monthly sunrise/sunset calendar for a location by name. Returns one item per day with the date, sunrise and sunset text.
